The structure of Mg12Zn2Bi2 (reduced formula Mg6ZnBi) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Bi and Zn each surrounded by 12 Mg neighbors in close-packed-like local arrangements, while Mg centers adopt 12-neighbor environments involving varying Bi, Mg, and Zn counts. These 12-vertex coordination polyhedra display corner-, edge-, and face-sharing contacts, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
